messages:
Liam: hello team! first day here. following the quickstart but `kubectl get pods -n dev` returns `Error from server (Forbidden)`. I'm on SSO. Who should I reach out to for kubeconfig/RBAC?
Kara (eng-infra): welcome Liam :wave: can you share `kubectl config current-context` and `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n dev`? Also confirm your redwood email.
Liam: current-context: `rwd-dev-eu`, `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n dev` -> no, email liam@redwood.com.
sso-bot: Created INFRA-2744 for liam@redwood.com. Assigned: Kara. ETA ~25m.
Kara (eng-infra): thanks. Two quick fixes: (A) we add your SSO group to a RoleBinding in `dev`, or (B) create a short-lived namespace-scoped serviceaccount so you can follow the workshop right away. Which do you prefer?
Liam: need to finish the workshop today, so (B) is best. Also worried about accidentally running things in prod since I have many contexts.
Kara (eng-infra): understood. I'm creating a SA now. To fetch a token locally run:```bash
kubectl -n dev create serviceaccount liam-onboard || true
TOKEN=$(kubectl -n dev create token liam-onboard --duration=6h)
kubectl config set-credentials liam-onboard --token="$TOKEN"
kubectl config set-context liam-dev --cluster=rwd-dev-cluster --namespace=dev --user=liam-onboard
kubectl config use-context liam-dev
```This gives a dedicated context `liam-dev`. For prod protection we recommend `export KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/liam-dev` per terminal or use our `kube-switch` helper which warns on prod contexts.
Liam: ran the commands and `kubectl get pods -n dev` works now, thanks! Much better.
Marta: security tip: serviceaccount tokens appear in audit logs. If you need admin perms for a demo request a timed elevation via the access portal so it's logged and expires automatically.
Eli: also note SSO group sync can lag; if Kara updates directory membership you may need to `aws-sso logout` / `aws-sso login` or reauth your OIDC session for the RBAC change to show up.
Kara (eng-infra): I added a RoleBinding for `group:developers` in `dev` so after you reauth you won't need the token. I'll leave the SA token active for 6h then revoke it.
Liam: confirmed — after re-login my SSO group shows `developers` and I can `kubectl` without the temp context. Appreciate the help and the warm welcome everyone! :smile:
Kara (eng-infra): welcome aboard Liam. If anything else breaks DM me or drop into #eng-infra.
